# Genzee Switchgears Private Limited

> Genzee Switchgears Private Limited is a Ghaziabad-based (Uttar Pradesh) manufacturer of electrical distribution equipment for industrial, commercial and residential use. Its range covers MCB boxes and MCB distribution boards, TPN and three-phase distribution boxes, busbar chambers, changeover switches, main switch boxes, kitkat cutout fuses, and industrial switchgear (single phase, three phase, 440V, HRC type and MCCB). Prices are provided on quotation; buyers can request one by phone, WhatsApp or the contact form.

Key facts:
- Business: Genzee Switchgears Private Limited (website: switchgearsmanufacturer.com)
- Address: First Floor, 345a-345b, Sahibabad, Gali No 3, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, 201005, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9136508089
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919136508089
- GSTIN: 09AAKCG9855E1Z3
- Experience (per the site): 10+ years, 500+ completed projects, a 6-acre manufacturing facility, 25+ products
- Industries served: industrial manufacturing units, commercial buildings and complexes, infrastructure and construction projects, warehouses and industrial facilities, power distribution and utilities, residential and light commercial
- Customisation: tailored distribution boards and boxes (such as TPN boards) for specific project needs
- Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/people/Genzee-Switchgears/61588682865617/ , Instagram https://www.instagram.com/genzee.prince/ , YouTube https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCf_yUu-rds0bQQKWX7tCD5A
- Service area: pan-India supply, with about 100 city pages
